{{nihongo|'''Izanagi Shrine'''|伊邪那岐神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}, {{ill|Kitakatsuragi District, Nara|ar|شيكي كيتاكاتسوراغي|ca|Districte de Kita-Katsuragi|es|Distrito de Kitakatsuragi|fr|District de Kitakatsuragi|id|Distrik Kitakatsuragi, Nara|it|Distretto di Kitakatsuragi|ja|北葛城郡|ko|기타카쓰라기군|nl|Kitakatsuragi (district)|pl|Powiat Kitakatsuragi|ru|Китакацураги (уезд)|zh|北葛城郡|qid=Q1131013}}, {{ill|Kanmaki, Nara|Q1203559|qid=Q1203559}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|ja|社格|ko|사격 (신토)|zh|社格|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Son-sha|Q134917284|qid=Q134917284}}. It is situated at the southern edge of the {{ill|Kataoka Castle ruins|ja|片岡城|qid=Q11569697|lt=Kataoka Castle ruins}}. {{nihongo|'''Izanagi Shrine'''|伊邪那岐神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

== Enshrined deities ==
{{ill|Izanagi|Q813858|qid=Q813858|lt=Izanagi-no-Mikoto}} is enshrined as the principal deity, with {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto|qid=Q2564508}} ({{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|fr|Kasuga no Kami|ja|春日神|simple|Kasuga-no-Kami|zh|春日神|qid=Q11088805}}), {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|Q317997|qid=Q317997}} ({{ill|Hachiman|ar|هاتشيمان|az|Haçiman|ca|Hachiman|de|Hachiman|el|Χατσίμαν|es|Hachiman|eu|Hachiman|fa|هاچیمان|fi|Hachiman|fr|Hachiman|hu|Hacsiman|id|Hachiman|it|Hachiman|ja|八幡神|ko|하치만 신|mni|ꯍꯆꯤꯃꯥꯟ|my|ဟချိမန်း|pl|Hachiman|pt|Hachiman|ru|Хатиман|simple|Hachiman|sl|Hačiman|sv|Hachiman|tok|jan sewi Kasiman|tr|Hachiman|uk|Хачіман|uz|Hachiman|vi|Hachiman|wuu|八幡神|zh|八幡神|qid=Q261637}}), the {{ill|Sumiyoshi sanjin|Q1114013|qid=Q1114013|lt=Sumiyoshi Sanjin}}, and {{ill|Ukanomitama|de|Ukanomitama|eo|Ukanomitama|fr|Uka-no-Mitama|ja|ウカノミタマ|mni|ꯎꯀꯅꯣꯃꯤꯇꯃ|ru|Ука-но митама|simple|Ukanomitama|sv|Ukanomitama|th|อูกาโนมิตามะ|zh|宇迦之御魂神|qid=Q3080728|lt=Ukanomitama-no-Mikoto}} ({{ill|Inari Ōkami|abstract|Q719665|ar|إناري|az|İnari Okami|ban|Inari (Kami)|bcl|Inari Ōkami|ca|Oinari|cs|Inari (mytologie)|da|Inari|de|Inari (Kami)|el|Ινάρι Όκαμι|es|Inari (Japón)|et|Inari (jumal)|eu|Inari Ōkami|fa|ایناری|fi|Inari (kami)|fr|Inari (divinité japonaise)|hr|Inari|hu|Inari (sintó)|hy|Ինարի Օկամի|id|Inari (Kami)|it|Inari (mitologia)|ja|稲荷神|jv|Inari (Kami)|ko|이나리노카미|mni|ꯏꯅꯔꯤ ꯑꯣꯀꯃꯤ|ne|इनारी ओकामी|nl|Inari Ōkami|no|Inari|pl|Inari (bóstwo)|pt|Inari Ōkami|ru|Инари (божество)|simple|Inari Ōkami|sl|Inari (mitologija)|sr|Инари (богиња)|sv|Inari|tok|jan sewi suli Inali|tr|Inari Ōkami|uk|Інарі (міфологія)|vi|Inari Ōkami|zh|稻荷神|qid=Q719665}}) enshrined jointly.

== History ==
The date of foundation is unknown. The earliest documentary reference appears in the {{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|cs|Nihon Sandai Džicuroku|de|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|es|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fa|نیهون ساندای جیتسوروکو|ff|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|fr|Nihon sandai jitsuroku|it|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ja|日本三代実録|ko|일본삼대실록|pt|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|ru|Нихон сандай дзицуроку|simple|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|zh|日本三代實錄|zh_classical|日本三代實錄|qid=Q1052981}}, under the entry for the 27th day of the first month of {{ill|Jōgan|Q1075635|qid=Q1075635|lt=Jōgan}} 1 ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}), which records the granting of the Junior Fifth Rank Upper Grade {{ill|Shinkai (divine rank)|Q11591025|qid=Q11591025}}. In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}, it is listed as “{{ill|Yamato Province|be|Ямата (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Yamato|ckb|پارێزگای یەماتۆ|cs|Provincie Jamato|de|Provinz Yamato|el|Επαρχία Γιαμάτο|es|Provincia de Yamato|fa|ولایت یاماتو|fi|Yamaton provinssi|fr|Province de Yamato|gl|Provincia de Yamato|hak|Yamato-koet|id|Provinsi Yamato|it|Yamato (provincia)|ja|大和国|ko|야마토국|lt|Jamato žemė|nl|Yamato (provincie)|no|Yamato (provins)|pt|Província de Yamato|ro|Provincia Yamato|ru|Ямато (провинция)|simple|Yamato Province|sk|Jamato (provincia)|sr|Провинција Јамато|th|แคว้นยามาโตะ|tr|Yamato (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ямато|ur|یاماتو صوبہ|zh|大和國|zh_min_nan|Yamato-kok|zh_yue|大和國|qid=Q907495}} {{ill|Katsuge district|ja|葛下郡|zh|葛下郡|qid=Q11620862}} Izanagi Shrine” and is classified as a minor shrine.

It is said that the shrine was originally located on Oshiyama to the east, but was moved to its present site as a {{ill|Guardian deities|ja|守護神|qid=Q131278957}} when {{ill|Kataoka Castle|ja|片岡城|qid=Q11569697}} was constructed. Until the Edo period, it was known as '''Gosha Myōjin''' (the Shrine of the Five Deities).

In Meiji 7 ({{ill|1875|ab|1875|af|1875|als|1875|am|1875 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1875|ar|1875|ary|1875|arz|1875|ast|1875|av|1875 сон|avk|1875|az|1875|azb|۱۸۷۵ (میلادی)|ba|1875 йыл|ban|1875|bar|1875|bat_smg|1875|bcl|1875|be|1875|be_x_old|1875|bg|1875|bn|১৮৭৫|bpy|মারি ১৮৭৫|br|1875|bs|1875.|ca|1875|cdo|1875 nièng|ce|1875 шо|ceb|1875|ckb|١٨٧٥|crh|1875|cs|1875|csb|1875|cv|1875|cy|1875|da|1875|de|1875|diq|1875|el|1875|eml|1875|eo|1875|es|1875|et|1875|eu|1875|fa|۱۸۷۵|fi|1875|fiu_vro|1875|fo|1875|fr|1875|frp|1875|frr|1875|fur|1875|fy|1875|ga|1875|gan|1875年|gcr|1875|gd|1875|gl|1875|gn|1875|gv|1875|hak|1875-ngièn|he|1875|hi|१८७५|hif|1875|hr|1875.|hsb|1875|ht|1875 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1875|hy|1875|hyw|1875 թուական|ia|1875|id|1875|ilo|1875|io|1875|is|1875|it|1875|ja|1875年|jv|1875|ka|1875|kaa|1875|kk|1875 жыл|ko|1875년|krc|1875 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1875|ku|1875|kv|1875-ӧд во|la|1875|lb|1875|lez|1875 йис|li|1875|lij|1875|lld|1875|lmo|1875|lt|1875 m.|lv|1875. gads|mai|१८७५|map_bms|1875|mdf|1875|mg|1875|mhr|1875|mi|1875|min|1875|mk|1875|ml|1875|mn|1875 он|mr|इ.स. १८७५|mrj|1875 и|ms|1875|my|၁၈၇၅|myv|1875 ие|mzn|۱۸۷۵|nah|1875|nap|1875|nds|1875|new|सन् १८७५|nl|1875|nn|1875|no|1875|nov|1875|nrm|1875|nso|1875|oc|1875|olo|1875|or|୧୮୭୫|os|1875-æм аз|pa|1875|pl|1875|pnb|1875|pt|1875|qu|1875|ro|1875|ru|1875 год|rue|1875|sa|१८७५|sah|1875|scn|1875|sd|1875ع|se|1875|sh|1875.|shn|1875|si|1875|simple|1875|sk|1875|sl|1875|smn|1875|sq|1875|sr|1875|stq|1875|su|1875|sv|1875|sw|1875|szl|1875|ta|1875|te|1875|tg|Соли 1875|th|พ.ศ. 2418|tk|1875|tl|1875|tly|1875|tr|1875|tt|1875 ел|udm|1875 ар|uk|1875|ur|1875ء|uz|1875|vec|1875|vi|1875|vls|1875|vo|1875|wa|1875|war|1875|wuu|1875年|xmf|1875|yi|1875|za|1875 nienz|zea|1875|zh|1875年|zh_classical|一八七五年|zh_min_nan|1875 nî|zh_yue|1875年|qid=Q7764}}), it was ranked as a village shrine, and in Meiji 40 ({{ill|1907|Q2048|qid=Q2048}}), it was designated a shrine receiving offerings of sacred food and ritual implements.
